title: Subscription fixture, v0
description: A language-neutral local test input for a subscription Contribution, since Plugin API 0.2. Tools (quivr plugin dev, the Contract Runner, SDK test helpers) turn it into a subscription request: they number the evaluations e1, e2, ... in order, give each one development Subscription ids, derive the Record Version ids and the idempotency key from the SHA-256 of the fixture bytes, default the record metadata (source dev-namespace/dev-record-<digest>, origin client, accepted_at 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z) when the fixture omits it, and validate every expression and configuration against the manifest schemas. A fixture file is told apart from an invocation fixture by its top-level evaluations property.

configuration.description: Plugin (installer) configuration; validated against the manifest configuration schema. Defaults to an empty object.
Subscription evaluator configuration. Defaults to an empty object.

expect.description: Expected decision. The Contract Runner and quivr plugin dev report a different answer.
